kv_cache.note: SLAM's persistent cache is a single Level-1 K/V bank (measured from its real cache tensors). Baseline figure is the standard per-layer KV cache a decoder of its shape would keep. CAVEAT: SLAM's cache is NOT an autoregressive inference cache — it is computed once from the full input sequence (which is also why it leaks future information); the memory saving and the causality bug are the same design decision.
